Convert between positions, supervoxels and root IDs

octo_xyz2id.Rd

octo_xyz2id() finds the neuron (root ID) or supervoxel at positions, octo_rootid() the current root ID of supervoxels, and octo_leaves() the supervoxels (or level-2 chunks) that make up a neuron.

Usage

octo_xyz2id(xyz, voxels = TRUE, root = TRUE)

octo_rootid(svids)

octo_leaves(id, level = 1)

Arguments

xyz

positions: n x 3 matrix / data.frame, or text like "1234, 5678, 910" (see parse_position())

voxels

TRUE if positions are Spelunker voxel coordinates, FALSE if they are nm

root

return root IDs (TRUE) or supervoxel IDs (FALSE)

svids

supervoxel IDs (character)

id

one root ID (character)

level

1 for supervoxels, 2 for level-2 chunks (far fewer, faster)

Value

character vector of IDs ("0" where a position hits no segment)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
octo_xyz2id("11434, 13413, 2501")
octo_xyz2id(cbind(91472, 107304, 20008), voxels = FALSE)
} # }
